_comment: vendor_shop.json - stock lists for general goods vendors. A vendor_npc.gd instance exports shop_id, which selects one of these tables. Buy/sell prices are derived from the item's own 'value'/'currency_type' fields in items.json (via Global.item_value_in_copper()), not duplicated here - buy_price_multiplier and sell_price_multiplier scale that base value for this vendor.
